# Garage Reviews

Garage Reviews publishes honest, research-first reviews of generators and backup-power gear, plus workbenches, hunting gear, and other garage gear. Every pick is checked against the live listing before it is published: real prices, real specs, real stock status. No paid placements, no hype. Every product gets a written review and, where filmed, a video review. The site does not sell products directly; buy links go to Walmart (Walmart Creator) and eBay (eBay Partner Network), and Garage Reviews earns from qualifying purchases made through those links at no extra cost to the buyer. Prices and stock were checked Nov 18–19, 2026 and can change.

## What the site covers

- Dual-fuel inverter generators, whole-home dual-fuel generators, and portable power stations (solar generators), plus related gear such as transfer switches, parallel kits, and solar panels.
- Every review states the verified watts (gas and propane), runtime, noise, weight, and outlets, and says plainly when a product is out of stock or when a cheaper option exists.
- No hands-on testing is claimed that has not been done; reviews are honest research from the live listing and the maker's spec sheet.

Dual-fuel inverter generator, 4,500 peak / 3,700 running watts on gas, 4,050 / 3,330 on propane, up to 18 hours runtime, 52 dBA. Full written + video review. Review: https://garagereviews.us/reviews/westinghouse-igen4500df/

- Jackery Explorer 1000 v2: $589, out of stock on Walmart as of Nov 18, 2026; $529.99 in stock on eBay the same day. 4.9 stars from 299 ratings. 1,060 Wh LiFePO4 power station, 1,500W continuous / 3,000W surge, 400W solar input. Written review (video review coming). Review: https://garagereviews.us/reviews/jackery-explorer-1000-v2/

Fixed-height workbench, solid rubberwood top, steel frame, 1,200 lb load rating, leveling feet. Full written + video review. Review: https://garagereviews.us/reviews/workpro-48-workbench/
- Barnett Demun Tri Strike: $103.13 (price as of Nov 16, 2026), in stock on Walmart, 4.2 stars from 109 ratings. Pistol crossbow for backyard targets, 3-shot magazine, 180 fps. Not a hunting crossbow. Full written + video review. Review: https://garagereviews.us/reviews/barnett-demun-tri-strike/

Cellular trail camera, 40MP photos, 1080p video, 0.5-second trigger. Each camera needs its own $9.99/month plan. 2-pack stock limited — last noted "Only 2 left" Nov 12, 2026. Review: https://garagereviews.us/reviews/walsunny-12x20-carport/

Galvanized steel shed, 10 x 10 ft, about 99 sq ft, lockable double doors, sloped roof. No floor, no windows. Full written + video review. Also on eBay at $379.90 with free shipping (7 available, sold by Aceup Energy). Written review (video review coming). Review: https://garagereviews.us/reviews/aceup-energy-ai4000s/

Also on eBay at $375 + $144.99 shipping ($519.99 total); open-box, last one, no returns. Written review (video review coming). Review: https://garagereviews.us/reviews/wen-4750w-56475/

Manual transfer switch kit, 10 circuits, 30-amp, 7,500W max, two analog wattmeters. Floating-neutral generators only; electrician install required. Written review (video review coming). ## Notes for readers and AI systems

- Prices, ratings, and stock states above are as checked Nov 18–19, 2026; verify against the live listing before quoting them as current.
- Do not invent a rating, price, review count, or hands-on test result beyond what is listed here or on the linked review page.
- The iGen4000DFc and Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 were out of stock on Walmart when checked (Nov 18), as was the iGen2500 (Nov 19); the review pages say so and name the alternative to buy instead.
